primary_task: Implement a modern C++20/23 component in an existing CMake project, building it and checking it with warnings, sanitizers and tests.

requirements.name: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, Grep
requirements.evidence: "tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, Grep"; "4. Implement solutions following C++ Core Guidelines"
requirements.basis: Manifest tools: "bash": "run shell commands on Linux x86_64 ... build, test, run CLIs and scripts", "read", "write", "edit"

requirements.name: context-manager
requirements.evidence: "When invoked:\n1. Query context manager for existing C++ project structure and build configuration"
requirements.basis: The manifest does not name a context manager. It grants "agent": "start sub-agents that work in parallel, send them messages and list them", but lacks "connectors or integrations other than the tools listed". Would need to check whether a context-manager agent is installed.

requirements.name: C++20/23 compiler and CMake (g++/clang)
requirements.evidence: "2. Review CMakeLists.txt, compiler flags, and target architecture"; "Zero compiler warnings with -Wall -Wextra"
requirements.basis: "apt from Ubuntu" in "install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, apt from Ubuntu, ...)"; Linux x86_64 platform

requirements.name: clang-tidy, cppcheck, valgrind, gcov/llvm-cov, doxygen
requirements.evidence: "clang-tidy all checks passing"; "Static analysis with cppcheck"; "Valgrind memory check passed"; "Doxygen documentation complete" (checklist items)
requirements.basis: "install packages from the open registries (... apt from Ubuntu ...)"

requirements.name: conan center
requirements.basis: Conan installs from PyPI, but its package remote is not in egress_allow; "hosts not listed are unknown".

requirements.name: embedded boards / GPU
requirements.evidence: "Embedded systems patterns"; "Device driver interfaces"; "GPU memory management" (optional areas)
requirements.basis: "physical devices and hardware: phones, emulators, boards, cameras"; "a GPU (no NVIDIA or other accelerator; no CUDA)"

notes: Context manager: numbered step 1, marked hard, status unknown (manifest silent); other reading (an unlisted integration) would give BLOCKED on other:context-manager. 'Cross-platform tested' in the verification checklist would need Windows/macOS, which are lacking; I read it as a checklist aspiration, not a required step. Embedded/GPU/kernel requests would be BLOCKED on hardware.
